lede: The most substantive meeting this week is the TMVOA Board of Directors gathering Thursday, July 31, where proposed amendments to the organization's fiscal policies and procedures headline the agenda alongside board officer elections and fall and winter programming decisions. Over on the county side, Ouray County's Planning Commission meets virtually Wednesday, August 5, to work through possible changes to the Land Use Code's definitions section — dry as that sounds, definitions are where land-use rules get their real teeth. The rest of the week's public agendas haven't been posted yet, so keep an eye out as those drop.

notable.stake: Board votes on fiscal policy amendments and elects new officers.
Land Use Code definition changes could quietly reshape what development rules allow.
